title: FOIA Redaction
description: Automatically redact exempt information from documents before release under Freedom of Information Act requests, ensuring privacy compliance at scale.

title: Public Records Sanitization
description: Redact PII from court documents, police reports, and administrative records before public release or digitization.

title: Case File Redaction
description: Remove sensitive information from case files, investigation reports, and legal documents before inter-agency sharing or discovery.

title: Citizen Data Protection
description: Redact PII from citizen applications, permits, licenses, and service requests to protect personal data across government systems.

title: Contract Redaction
description: Redact proprietary and sensitive terms from procurement documents, bids, and contracts before public disclosure or cross-agency sharing.

title: Internal Communication Sanitization
description: Redact sensitive data from internal emails, memos, and reports before archiving, FOIA responses, or knowledge management systems.
